info.title: Kuwaiti Experience Car Rental API
info.description: Car rental search, quote, reservation and booking-fee payment for the mobile app. Inventory is managed in the CMS. The app charges only the booking fee through MyFatoorah; the rental amount is paid to the provider at pickup. Money is a three-decimal KWD string. Responses use the shared envelope; image keys are resolved through meta.images. See rental-api.md for the flow.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Vehicle id

Location.description: A pickup place from the shared list. Send its id as pickup_location_id / return_location_id.

quote.description: Present when pickup_at and return_at were sent.

extra_km_rate.description: KWD per km over mileage_limit_km, collected by the provider. null when not charged or mileage is unlimited.

rental_mode.description: with_driver vehicles are always booked and quoted with a driver.

is_saved.description: True when the signed-in customer saved this vehicle. Always false for guests; send the customer bearer token to get the real value.

days.description: Each started 24 hours counts as a day.

pickup_area.description: Service area of the searched address; null without an address or while no areas exist.

gallery.description: Cover first, then the gallery. Resolve through meta.images.

insurance.description: Localized label of the insurance cover chosen in the CMS.

locations.description: Places where this car can be picked up.

available.description: null when no period was sent.

rental_terms.description: Ordered rental terms managed in the CMS; show as chips.

pickup_location_id.description: A place id from GET /rentals/locations. Leave out for an address pickup.

return_location_id.description: Optional. Cars are returned at the pickup location; if sent it must equal pickup_location_id.

pickup_name.description: Address pickup (with driver): the address text. Required with pickup_lat/pickup_lng.

pickup_lat.description: Address pickup (with driver): latitude of the map spot.

pickup_lng.description: Address pickup (with driver): longitude of the map spot.

pickup_saved_address_id.description: Address pickup (with driver): one of the customer's saved addresses.

CreateBookingRequest.description: Send exactly one pickup: pickup_location_id; or, with with_driver=true, pickup_name + pickup_lat + pickup_lng (a map spot) or pickup_saved_address_id.

extra_km_rate.description: KWD per km over mileage_limit_km, collected by the provider. null when not charged or mileage is unlimited.

rental_terms.description: Ordered rental terms managed in the CMS; show as chips.

driver.description: The provider's driver for a with-driver booking, once assigned (confirmed or completed bookings). `null` until a driver is assigned and always for self-drive. Resolve `photo_image_key` through `meta.images`. A push notification of type `rental_driver_assigned` is sent when a driver is assigned or changed.

can_review.description: True once the rental has ended (completed, or confirmed and past return_at). Allows creating or editing the review.

return.description: Where the rental ends. For an address pickup it is the same address (the driver drops the customer back there); for a branch pickup type is 'branch' and return_location applies.

RatingSummary.description: Published reviews only. average is rounded to one decimal and null when count is 0.

status.description: hidden means staff removed it from public lists.

branch.description: This provider's branch at the place.

working_hours.description: null: no fixed hours. Times are Kuwait time.

BookingPickup.description: Where the rental starts. 'branch': the customer collects the car at pickup_location. 'address': the driver collects the customer at address and sets off from pickup_location.
